instructions.text: Stir the ground coffee with one egg and part of the shell, adding a half cupful of cold water
Put it into the coffee boiler, and pour on to it a quart of boiling water
As it rises and begins to boil, stir it down with a silver spoon or fork
Boil hard for ten or twelve minutes
Remove from the fire and pour out a cupful of coffee, then pour back into the coffeepot
Place it on the back of the stove or range where it will keep hot and not boil
It will settle in about five minutes
Serve with good cream and lump sugar

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Stir the ground coffee with one egg and part of the shell, adding a half cupful of cold water
2. Put it into the coffee boiler, and pour on to it a quart of boiling water
3. As it rises and begins to boil, stir it down with a silver spoon or fork
4. Boil hard for ten or twelve minutes
5. Remove from the fire and pour out a cupful of coffee, then pour back into the coffeepot
6. Place it on the back of the stove or range where it will keep hot and not boil
7. It will settle in about five minutes
8. Send to the table hot
9. Serve with good cream and lump sugar
